{{Quote|Brinn--our groundskeeper--tried to distract them anyway. The Killiks... well, there's not much left of him now.|Alek Terral describes Brinns sacrifice|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Brinn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as groundskeeper of [[House Teraan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. When the [[House Teral]] estate was overrun by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], Brinn tried use the insecticide mines until he was attacked by these insectoids. A Republic spacer was tasked by [[Alek Teral]] to recover the insecticide mines from Brinn's corpse.
